title: Orka.ai targeted RAG regression — retrieval update
note: Three previously failing cases selected to evaluate the updated schema-separated and SQL-example retrieval. Gold SQL is executed locally to calculate expected results.

cases.question: Find customers who have at least one cancelled order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Cancelled' ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Show distinct products included in each order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: Which product category has the highest total revenue?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category LIMIT 1;
